svg.title: The projected-payout identity uses the simple-group projection hypothesis and the stipulated period n > 20. There are also low and high path corrections. Denote their averaged sums by F∆and Hα,∆, and the low loan sum by Lα,∆. Their defining termwise identities, summed with the same masks, are (α + ∆)KR + F∆+ Hα,∆= αR + ∆ X o headsp(o, ·) + Lα,∆.
